page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6a.16xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 7H12 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. Managed under the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 64 vCPUs and 256 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio equivalent to 4 GB of RAM per virtual core.

The ecs.g6a.16xlarge instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring attached cloud block storage for operating system and persistent application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned. From a hardware density standpoint, the high vCPU and memory allocation provide strong consolidation benefits for multi-threaded applications, with the lack of local disk standing as an operational trade-off requiring external storage infrastructure.

Given the balanced compute-to-memory footprint and 64-core density, this server configuration fits enterprise web application hosting, containerized microservices clusters, build and integration pipelines, distributed caching nodes, and general business application deployments.
